devices.line: Your brains, settings and projects on your phone or another computer too. A task stays on the device it was done on, until you send it to another.
devices.lineStore: Your tasks, files, brains and settings on your phone or another computer too, sealed so that only your devices can read them.
devices.safe: Your tasks and files are also on your other devices, sealed so only they can read them.
devices.lastSeen: {device} was last seen {when}. If you no longer use it, remove it.
devices.store.full: Full: what is new stays on this device.
devices.store.owed: Shutting out the device you removed…
devices.store.gone: This device no longer gets what your other devices do.
devices.store.room: This device is out of room: nothing more comes to it.
devices.own: Each device keeps its own theme, synced folder, downloaded brains and sign-ins to services.
devices.store.unreached: This device can’t reach your other devices right now: what changes here waits until it can.
devices.paste: A link from your other device
devices.joinText: On the device that has your {name}, open {place} and choose Add a device. Not there yet? It’s in {case}. Then point this device’s camera at its code, or paste its link here.
devices.open: Open this on your other device
devices.qr: The link as a QR code, for your other device’s camera
devices.point: Point your other device’s camera at the code, or send it the link.
devices.pasteThere: Open this link on your other device, or paste it into {name}’s box there.
devices.link: The link to open on your other device
devices.codeHint: They show on the new device once it opens the link. Three tries.

devices.wrong.one: Those digits don’t match. {count} try left.
devices.wrong.other: Those digits don’t match. {count} tries left.

devices.done: {device} is added. It opens with your brains, settings and projects.
devices.coming: Your {name} on your other device comes to this one, with its brains, settings and projects. You then type six digits there.
devices.typeThere: Type these on your other device
devices.trustHint: Only if you just chose Add a device there yourself.
devices.homeTitle: First, add {name} to your Home Screen
devices.homeText: On an iPhone or iPad, {name} on the Home Screen keeps its things apart from Safari’s. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and open it from there.
devices.homePaste: There, paste this link into the box.
devices.why.link: This isn’t a link from your other device. Copy it again there.
devices.why.used: This link was already used. On your other device, choose Add a device again for a new one.
devices.why.gone: Your other device stopped adding this one. Start again there.
devices.why.key: The answer came from another device than the link’s, so nothing was added. Start again.
devices.why.child: A child’s profile stays on its own device.
devices.why.relay: Your other devices can’t be reached right now. Check the connection and try again.
devices.why.storage: This browser can’t keep {name}’s files here, in a private window for instance.
devices.why.exists: Your {name} from that device is already here.
devices.why.tries: Three wrong tries: adding stopped, to be safe. Start again.
devices.removeText: It no longer gets your settings, and tasks can’t be sent to it.
devices.notYet: {device} hasn’t been told yet. This device tells it on its own as soon as it can.
devices.erasing: {name} is erased from it the next time it opens.
devices.revoke: It may still hold these keys, since a key can’t be taken back. To be safe, replace each one where you made it:
devices.people: Your people get your new key now. Remove from People anyone you don’t know: they may have been added from the device you removed.
devices.sites: It may still change these sites online. To stop it, open each one, choose Publish…, then Make a new recovery code:
devices.task.kept: This project is kept on this device.
devices.task.large: This task is too big to send to {device}.
devices.task.gone: {device} isn’t one of your devices any more.
devices.task.failed: Couldn’t send it to {device}. Try again in a moment.
devices.forgotten: Another of your devices removed this one. {name} stays here, on its own.
